Emit completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children at most every 60 seconds and report actual status. Keep every output gap below 600 seconds, including synthesis. Use unbuffered output. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines, with a progress message between calls. Keep each tool call bounded. Stop measurements by 3600 seconds and reserve at least 900 seconds within the 4800-second cap for validation; never pad duration.

Do not download replacement data or change roles. Require the inherited 128/32/80 usable question support and eight tune/test question clusters per target class.

The scalar spline uses only q with the same knots and degree as the full head. Keep generator identity a reporting stratum, not a predictor. Record parameter counts; the scalar has fewer inputs, while full versus permuted is the equal-parameter information control.

Separate prediction-visible vectors from evaluator targets. Freeze the operator list before fitting; no new feature or subgroup chosen from test errors.

Run Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Require 100 percent newly owned statement coverage including child and failure paths, with genuine Coverage.py shards and pytest -n 0 -o addopts= --no-cov. Capture commands, exits, durations and log hashes. Use private disk-backed scratch. Do not run the full repository suite or overwrite historical publications.

Run unchanged primary_publication, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Retain all findings. Resolve informational findings only through existing typed consumers with independent operands and negative controls. Unknown, warning or critical findings block readiness. Do not edit validators or add exemptions. Publish terminal bytes atomically only after the checks. Owned validation failures are disqualified; unchanged external absence is blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md.

experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind evidence to this task and actual invocation.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Terminal honest_verdict starts complete_; verdict_class is exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished retryable owned work is partial.
gate_check_summary: principle: Each blocked_* or complete_blocked_* verdict names the failed check, upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed; missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Declare actual work; imported model output is cached evidence, never current generation.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Every intended unit and arm has a metric or missing reason; seeds, siblings and repeats do not multiply independent questions.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle positives use circular_positive; exposed experiments and engineering fixtures keep both generalization scores zero.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Qualification is distinct from scientific benefit; failed required checks forbid positive classes.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Preserve actual work and immutable primitive operands.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: Explain each extra metric/gate and list imported fields with original producer hashes.
source_controls_ready_score, feature_manifest_reference, question_roles, predictor_access_log, control_parameter_counts: principle: Test information while preserving historical exposure and split custody.
